positive_prompt: Loose fine-line observational drawing with subtle natural wobble; transparent restrained low-saturation watercolor; warm matte off-white paper influence; preserved object relationships; quiet editorial travel-journal character; soft edges that merge naturally into paper.
negative_prompt: No stamp, linocut, woodcut, vector icon, spot-color print, heavy black outline, distressed ink, generated typography, decorative border, route line, marker, watermark, collage seam, rectangular crop edge, white fringe, or pasted-photo artifact.

mark_edge_quality: fine observational line with natural wobble
soft watercolor edges that merge into paper
negative_space_rules: do not paint a full-page background
fill_tonal_rules: protect pale washes and avoid crushed shadows
background_cleanliness: empty areas match the shared paper master
no generated haze, speckle field, or rectangular plate patch
sample_style_contract_defaults.frame_border_policy: forbid generated frames, borders, crop edges, and plate seams
sample_style_contract_defaults.abstraction_level: selective observational simplification; preserve source identity and object relationships
